senses.sense_definition: The act of foreseeing or foretelling future events.

examples.text: Ancient cultures often relied on <w>divination</w> to make important decisions about war or harvest.
The priest performed a ritual of <w>divination</w> to interpret the signs of the coming storm.

senses.sense_definition: The practice of discovering secrets or the future through supernatural means.

examples.text: Many people in the past believed that <w>divination</w> could reveal hidden truths about their lives.
She studied various forms of <w>divination</w> to better understand the mysteries of the occult.

senses.sense_definition: A prediction or an indication of what is to come in the future.

examples.text: The oracle offered a cryptic <w>divination</w> that left the king feeling deeply unsettled.
His <w>divination</w> about the market crash proved to be surprisingly accurate in the end.
